name: Anisotropic Voxel Representation
definition: A voxel storage format that stores 6 directional values instead of a single non-directional value to prevent color mixing and opacity under-estimation during MIP-mapping (the 'two red-green wall problem').
summary: Anisotropic Voxel Representation stores six directional values per non-leaf node to preserve directional coherence, preventing light leaking and color mixing artifacts common in isotropic averaging.
